role: local government, land bank operator and planning participant
stance_basis: do-nothing alternative conflicts with City of Milwaukee goals; recommended corridor listed as compatible with City of Milwaukee Land Bank
summary: The City of Milwaukee appears as a land bank operator whose goals of promoting commercial and industrial growth in the area are cited as conflicting with the do-nothing alternative. The document also notes that several corridors (particularly Corridor #4) are described as most disruptive to the City's land bank area, while the recommended Corridor #5 and Corridor #3 are listed as compatible with the City of Milwaukee Land Bank. The City's land holdings and planning interests are referenced throughout the corridor comparisons.
complaint_summary: The do-nothing alternative is listed as conflicting with City of Milwaukee goals of promoting commercial and industrial growth in the area.
